requirements.requirement: Build the LinkedIn campaigns: CFO, Controller and AP manager titles at the account list, 200 to 1,000 employees. Manual bidding with a cost cap. LinkedIn Audience Network off. A Lead Gen Form that offers the Month-End Close Benchmark.
requirements.acceptance: Campaigns sit in draft with titles, company size and the account list applied, Audience Network off, and a test form submission reaches Salesforce.

requirements.requirement: Stop rule: pause any ad set whose cost per lead runs above $180 for two straight weeks. $180 is the most a lead can cost for the budget to reach the target.
requirements.acceptance: Every Monday the cost per lead of each ad set is compared to $180, and the ones above it for two weeks are paused.

requirements.requirement: Brief the syndication vendor: finance titles at US manufacturers of 200 to 1,000 employees, delivered weekly, with the benchmark PDF as the asset.
requirements.acceptance: The signed insertion order names the titles, the size band, the region, weekly delivery and the benchmark PDF.

requirements.requirement: Build the Month-End Close Benchmark: the 20-minute read-out from the buyer's own AP numbers, and a gated PDF version for syndication.
requirements.acceptance: The read-out runs end to end on a test account's AP numbers, and the PDF is approved.

requirements.requirement: Produce the webinar with the NetSuite partner: one customer speaker who closed on day 4, and the benchmark as the follow-up offer.
requirements.acceptance: The speaker is confirmed in writing, the run of show is approved, and the registration page is live.

requirements.requirement: Write one proof piece per named manufacturing customer, each showing the close moving to day 4.
requirements.acceptance: Each customer has approved its piece in writing.

requirements.requirement: Line up a second customer speaker for the webinar, from the three named manufacturing customers, briefed on the same run of show.
requirements.acceptance: A second speaker has confirmed in writing and has the run of show.

requirements.requirement: Forms on the benchmark page and the LinkedIn Lead Gen Form push every lead to Salesforce with the campaign and its UTMs.
requirements.acceptance: A test submission from each form shows the campaign and all four UTMs on the Salesforce lead.

requirements.requirement: Route benchmark leads from accounts on the list to the account's SDR. Leads from off-list accounts go to a review queue.
requirements.acceptance: A test lead from a listed account lands with its SDR, and one from an unlisted account lands in the review queue.

requirements.requirement: MQL definition: a lead from a target account, in a named buying role, who books a close review or attends the webinar.
requirements.acceptance: The definition is live in Salesforce and sales has signed off on it.

requirements.requirement: Dashboard: pipeline and opportunities against the $1.2M target by week, with leads and spend by channel against the weekly pacing in this brief.
requirements.acceptance: The dashboard shows a test week against the weekly targets, and the sales director can open it.

requirements.requirement: Follow-up SLA: an SDR calls every benchmark lead and every close review request within one business day.
requirements.acceptance: Salesforce shows a logged call within one business day on every campaign lead.

requirements.requirement: SDR outbound: sequences to Controllers and AP managers on the account list that open with the benchmark.
requirements.acceptance: Sequences are loaded in Outreach for every contact on the list and approved by the sales director.

requirements.requirement: Talk track and objection sheet: the day-4 close claim, the customer proof pieces, and answers on NetSuite and Sage Intacct integration.
requirements.acceptance: Every SDR and AE has run the talk track once in a role play with the sales director.

requirements.requirement: Capacity: the three AEs keep room for the opportunity flow in the pacing table through the run.
requirements.acceptance: Each week, every new campaign opportunity has an AE owner within one business day.

requirements.requirement: LinkedIn concepts on the day-4 close claim: single image and document ad formats, with two copy variants per concept.
requirements.acceptance: Final files in every LinkedIn size, approved against the core message.

requirements.requirement: Webinar promo kit: registration page art, email headers and social tiles.
requirements.acceptance: The kit is delivered and live on the registration page.

requirements.requirement: Test plan: run the LinkedIn concepts against each other for the first two weeks, then move budget to the concept with the lowest cost per opportunity.
requirements.acceptance: After two weeks, the winning concept holds the largest share of LinkedIn spend.
